title: Recording, mixing: The Lovely Linda, Glasses, Junk, Singalong Junk, Momma Miss America, Oo You by Paul McCartney | 1970
content:
Studio One, Morgan Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Robin Black

Paul McCartney mixed five songs for the McCartney album on 20 February 1970.

Much of the session was spent reworking ‘Oo You’, which had been recorded in December 1969 at his Cavendish Avenue home. McCartney re-recorded his vocals, added an electric guitar part, and overdubbed cowbell, tambourine, and the sound of an aerosol spray.

He and studio engineer Robin Black then made a rough mix of the song, and did the same for several other home recordings: ‘The Lovely Linda’, ‘Glasses’, ‘Junk’, ‘Singalong Junk’, and an edit of ‘Momma’ and ‘Miss America’, which became ‘Momma Miss America’.

None of the day’s mixes was released, and were most likely for McCartney’s own reference and evaluation.
